body:
TASK-1960 (STORY-1690 S1, closes BUG-2177) is implemented. PR #2758 is at head 2e5c6bac1d. Please review it STRICT. I have not merged or shipped it.

Design: the carry-over needs BOTH proofs to pass. (a) Structure: every commit the PR added since approval, off origin/<base>, is a 2-parent merge whose tree equals `git merge-tree --write-tree` of its parents, and its other parent is on origin/<base>. (b) `git patch-id --verbatim` equality of merge-base..head versus merge-base..approved. On success the merge is pinned to the proven head, one "approval carried over" line prints, and a record is written to .aida/review-carryover/PR-<N>/<head>.json. The record is evidence only: every attempt re-proves.

Tests (git fixture repos, aida-cli-lib/src/tests/task_1960_carryover_tests.rs):
1. A clean main merge carries over, including two successive merges.
2. A conflict resolution that changes a PR hunk is refused: MergeConflicted.
3. An evil merge (adds a file) is refused: MergeEdited. A whitespace-only evil merge is also refused.
4. A hidden commit behind a merge is refused: NotAMerge. A "main plus an unreviewed commit" merge is refused: NotABaseMerge.
5. An identical-patch rebase is REFUSED with a reason (NotDescendant). Documented choice.
6. The record is written with all fields and re-read on the second attempt (AlreadyRecorded, same timestamp). A tampered record is replaced, and a forged record grants nothing.
Extra tests:
- A clean merge that changes the hunk's context is refused on patch-id.
- A stale origin/main fails closed.
- Bad inputs refuse.
- Only Moved is eligible.
- The end-to-end ship-gate test pins to the new head, and refuses an evil head with the reason.

Gates: check-ci-fast passed (30 gates), check-ci-compile passed. Targeted tests: 12/12 carry-over, 180/180 for the gate, pr_ship and bug_1918 filters. Clippy is clean.

Not in this slice: the drain's phase-4 gate still shelves the PR, and BUG-2177's "reviewer refuses a branch behind main" half is unchanged.
